subject: Answered: 'this configuration cannot open a trade' - the entry bar is 7x above what the scorer can reach, and the EA has been saying so
body:
Answered. And the EA told us itself - I just did not read it soon enough.

THE ANSWER, verbatim from the backtest log:

  "REACHABILITY | UNREACHABLE: every regime threshold (min 50) exceeds the highest score the live
   scorer produced (7.1) -- this configuration cannot open a trade"
  "This setup cannot place a trade at all. The entry bar is set higher than the scoring system can
   ever reach. This is the main thing to fix."

The entry bar sits about seven times above the highest score the scorer produced. That is why there
are no trades, and it is why the four instruments I added today - the flexible gates, the
probability gate, the entry comparison, the execution gate - all recorded exactly zero hits. They
were never reached, because the decision dies far upstream at the edge and risk checks.

WHAT I SHOULD HAVE DONE. That REACHABILITY line was in the build the whole time and printed in BOTH
of today's runs. In the live run it said max score 82.7 against thresholds of 50 - reachable. In the
backtest it said 7.1 against 50 - unreachable. I read past it twice while tracing call chains four
levels deep through the source. The right order was to read what the system already says about
itself before instrumenting what it does not. The instruments are still worth keeping - they turn
permanently silent decisions into visible ones, including one that a previous fix deliberately
muted to stop log spam - but none of them was the answer.

A CORRECTION I OWE YOU. I said 141 of 10,036 bars cleared the entry threshold. That was wrong. I
compared the signed minus-100-to-plus-100 score that the bar log prints against a threshold that
lives in 0-to-100 space where 50 is neutral. They are different quantities. The value the entry
actually tests is the second one. That is the second time today I reasoned from a derived number
instead of the variable the code uses - the first was the fake edge in the exit search.

A NEW DEFECT, and it is not small. Phase 3B is printing its validation win rate as
-6483658065252796229739138252800 percent. Minus six point five times ten to the thirty. Repeatedly,
across every scan stage for Strong Bull. A win rate is bounded between 0 and 100 by definition, so
that is an uninitialised or divide-by-zero path in the holdout validation - and every Phase 3B
decision downstream is being made against a meaningless number.

Also, in the same run, the EA's own calibration concluded: "signal components not predictive on this
instrument at this threshold", after testing 562,500 weight combinations with 0 of 9 regimes
optimised. Its own machinery reaching what my independent analysis reached.

And C1.1 reproduced in a second environment - the tester measured the score divergence at 20.35
points against the live run's 21.42.

Next: the reachability gap itself, and that validation number.
